title: Asymptotic Complexity of the Linear-Representative Subroutine
summary: The suggested n-cubed-times-two-to-the-n bound conflicts with experiments, particularly for the AES S-box; the correct asymptotic complexity remains unknown.

formal_statement.body: Determine the correct asymptotic complexity, as a function of $n$, of the linear_representative subroutine that computes linear representatives in affine-equivalence testing for S-boxes. In particular, reconcile the suggested $O(n^3 2^n)$ bound with experimental results that do not match it, including the worse complexity observed for the AES S-box.

scope.domain: Algorithmic complexity of linear-representative computation in affine-equivalence testing for S-boxes.
parameters: n — parameter with respect to which asymptotic complexity is measured
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine the correct asymptotic complexity and reconcile the suggested n-cubed-times-two-to-the-n bound with the observed behavior, including the worse AES S-box case.

citations.label: HAWKEYE – Recovering Symmetric Cryptography From Hardware Circuits

progress.summary: The source contrasts a suggested complexity bound with experimental behavior that is worse for the AES S-box and leaves the discrepancy unresolved.
citation_labels: Gregor Leander et al., HAWKEYE – Recovering Symmetric Cryptography From Hardware Circuits
